one_sentence_story: Two quick inhales through your nose followed by one slow exhale flips a mechanical nerve brake on stress faster than trying to meditate your thoughts away.
so_what_for_you: When your heart races, don't try to force your mind blank. Do three to five minutes of double-inhale, long-exhale sighs to slow your pulse from the body up.

jargon_map.plain: Two back-to-back nasal inhales followed by one long, slow exhale through the mouth.
jargon_map.analogy: Topping off a tire with one extra puff of air before letting pressure out smoothly.

jargon_map.plain: Tiny air sacs in your lungs that flatten slightly during tense, shallow desk breathing.
jargon_map.analogy: Millions of tiny balloons that pop fully open on the second top-up sniff.

jargon_map.plain: The main calming nerve pathway that slows your heart rate whenever you extend your exhale.
jargon_map.analogy: Easing your foot onto a smooth hydraulic brake pedal on a downhill road.
